papers.abstract: The expansion of time-series data from sensors and monitoring systems has made compact representations increasingly important. Such representations should retain signal structure while cutting storage, transmission and computation costs. Adaptive Brownian Bridge-based Aggregation (ABBA) addresses this need by converting long numerical series into short symbolic sequences, but reductions in parameter storage and computational precision remain desirable. We propose Quantized ABBA (QABBA), a quantized version of ABBA. By quantizing the symbolic centers, QABBA reduces the parameter footprint and enables integer arithmetic while maintaining high reconstruction quality. We establish several error bounds for the additional approximation introduced by quantization: a dimension-free bound on the excess error of each segment, a time-domain reconstruction-error bound, a stability condition for symbolic assignment, and a rule for allocating bits between segment lengths and increments. The resulting symbolic strings can be passed directly to a pretrained large language model (LLM) without any extra time-series embedding layer. Experiments on the Monash regression archive, UCR Time Series Classification Archive, and UEA Multivariate Time Series Classification Archive demonstrate a practical trade-off among storage, reconstruction accuracy and downstream predictive performance. QABBA therefore provides an error-controlled, low-precision symbolic representation for time-series compression and LLM-based analysis.

analysis.key_results: 在 Monash 回归、UCR 时间序列分类和 UEA 多变量时间序列分类数据集上，QABBA 在存储、重建精度和下游预测性能之间实现了实际权衡。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 QABBA，一种对 ABBA 符号表示进行量化的方法，减少参数存储、支持整数运算，同时保持高重建质量，并可直接输入 LLM 进行分析。
analysis.method: 对 ABBA 的符号中心进行量化，推导出量化引入的额外误差边界、时间域重建误差界、符号分配稳定性条件以及分段长度与增量之间的比特分配规则。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出 Quantized ABBA（QABBA），对符号中心进行量化以降低参数存储和计算精度，同时保留信号结构并减少下游任务性能损失。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该研究关注符号时间序列压缩与量化，属于通用的模型量化与数据压缩技术，不直接涉及 VLA 或 WAM。对 VLA/WAM 等机器人模型没有直接关系，但其量化与整数运算思想可能对传感器数据流或时间序列信号的高效处理有潜在参考价值。

papers.title: QABBA: Symbolic Time-Series Compression via Integer-Quantized Aggregation
papers.title_zh: QABBA：通过整数量化聚合的符号化时间序列压缩方法
